outcome: provision rates of long-acting reversible contraception (LARC) within 3 and 60 days of delivery
provision rates of permanent contraception within 3 and 60 days of delivery
provision rates of moderately effective contraception within 3 and 60 days of delivery
cohort: The study included 45,916 deliveries in Maine from October 2015 through March 2021, derived from an All Payer Claims Database.
finding: At the start of the COVID-19 pandemic, the provision of LARC and moderately effective contraception within 3 days of delivery increased, while the provision of permanent contraception within 3 and 60 days of delivery decreased.
